query: UPDATE domain_reputation dr SET is_nrd = TRUE, nrd_source = youngest.slug FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.domain) d.domain, s.slug FROM indicator_domains d JOIN sources s ON d.source = s.id JOIN enrichment_bindings eb ON eb.source_id = s.id WHERE eb.enrichment_type = 'nrd' ORDER BY d.domain, s.slug ASC ) youngest WHERE youngest.domain = dr.registrable_domain AND (dr.is_nrd = FALSE OR dr.nrd_source IS DISTINCT FROM youngest.slug)
